title: Nvidia says it made a "substantial" investment in Safe Superintelligence, which will get access to Nvidia GPUs to up computing power by an "order of magnitude" (Keach Hagey/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Keach Hagey / Wall Street Journal: Nvidia says it made a “substantial” investment in Safe Superintelligence, which will get access to Nvidia GPUs to up computing power by an “order of magnitude” — Partnership with former top OpenAI scientist aims to boost chip giant's high-profile customer roster during AI boom
contentText:
Keach Hagey / Wall Street Journal :

Nvidia says it made a “substantial” investment in Safe Superintelligence, which will get access to Nvidia GPUs to up computing power by an “order of magnitude”   —  Partnership with former top OpenAI scientist aims to boost chip giant's high-profile customer roster during AI boom
